prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin, as only sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) have reached 2 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) were helpful as both included winning tests.
Finish copy changes (finish, copy) performed worse and hurt the finish rate.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, choose_path, finish (new_screen), and home (new_flow, wait_info) changes.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: -2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Pick Friend Stage Spotlight: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout spotlighting pet personalities and high-contrast preview cards to reduce decision fatigue. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and high completion time (1017s mean), indicating hesitation during pet selection.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Post-Certificate Reorder Flow: Move sign-in immediately after the adoption certificate screen to lock in account ownership right after naming the pet. (why: Lessons show sign-in reordering yielded positive noise-corrected gains (+6.6%), and placing account creation after pet certification increases user commitment.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interactive Controls Overview Screen: Introduce a dedicated tutorial screen before finishing onboarding that previews desktop overlay shortcuts, pet hiding, and dock controls. (why: Support theme [after_onboarding, confusion] shows users struggle to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Stage Companion Setup Flow: Embed a secondary configuration stage during pet asset rendering so users can preview desktop behaviors while waiting. (why: The waiting screen suffers from very long waiting times (201s median / 2336s mean), leading to drop-offs before completion.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in preserves pet customization across app restarts. (why: Support emails show 8 reports of pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Progress Stages: Display active rendering stage indicators and dynamic time estimates on the waiting screen to reassure users. (why: Long mean waiting times (2336s) and user confusion over whether rendering is active hurt home step conversion (81.3%).)
6: [home, notification] Background Pet Readiness Desktop Notification: Allow users to opt into a desktop system notification when pet rendering completes so they can safely minimize the app. (why: High mean waiting duration (2336s) leads users to abandon the app if kept open in focus.)

scores.note: Adoption has the highest user drop (60.9% conversion), but redesign requires substantial effort and past test showed modest +2.4% gain.
Sign-in reordering proved strong (+6.6% noise-corrected) and capitalizing on post-certificate motivation aligns with proven lessons.
Strong evidence from support logs and drop-off rate, but new screens historically yielded minimal impact (+1.2%) and require high cost.
New flows on the home/wait step previously hurt conversion (-3.2% noise-corrected) and require significant dev effort.
Low cost config update supported by explicit support mail evidence and historically reliable sign-in hint improvements (+1.8%).
Targeting long wait times is logical, but wait_info changes previously showed zero noise-corrected lift (+0.0%).
Addresses long wait times via background notifications, but requires native app release code.
